name: Opendoor
tagline: Digital hostel management & gate pass platform for university campuses.
description: Full-stack hostel management system with digital gate passes, QR-JWT scanning, concurrency-safe bed booking, payment processing, and real-time Socket.io updates.

name: SkillSphere
tagline: Peer-to-peer skill exchange platform connecting learners and teachers within communities.
description: A community-driven platform where users can list skills they want to teach and skills they want to learn, enabling organic skill-swap connections with scheduling and session management.
highlights: Organic skill-swap matching without monetary exchange
Integrated session scheduling and calendar sync

name: Intelli-Light
tagline: AI-driven adaptive street lighting system for smart cities and energy conservation.
description: An intelligent street lighting system using computer vision and ML to adaptively control light intensity based on real-time pedestrian and vehicle density, reducing energy consumption by up to 40%.
highlights: Real-time pedestrian and vehicle density detection
Adaptive dimming algorithm with 40% energy savings
Edge-deployed ML inference on low-cost hardware
